grain_rationale: row_count is 166158 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, meaning no exact duplicate rows exist and each row represents one scheduled flight segment (a transaction grain), not a pre-aggregated summary; no single column is unique on its own (flight_number has only 2994 distinct values against 166158 rows), so the identity is derived from the ordered tuple flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, which the zero duplicate_row_rate confirms is sufficient to distinguish every row without needing to aggregate.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: The calendar date the flight is scheduled to depart, ranging from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct dates with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: carrier_code

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: The carrier's flight number (1-8500, 2994 distinct values) that together with carrier_code and date labels a specific flight; stored as an integer but used as an identifier, not summed.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: The three-letter IATA code of the New York-area origin airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA), 3 distinct values, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm

fields.name: tail_number

fields.name: is_cancelled

fields.name: dep_hhmm

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes

fields.name: arr_hhmm

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: The scheduled arrival time encoded as HHMM (1-2359), null_rate 0.0, a label for the planned arrival slot.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: The arrival delay in minutes (-86 to 1272 observed), a measure for aggregating delay performance across flights; nullable with null_rate 0.032981.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: The recorded time in the air in minutes (20-695 observed), a measure summed or averaged for flight duration analysis; nullable with null_rate 0.032981 matching missing arrival data.

fields.name: distance_miles

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled commercial flight segment departing from a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) in 2013, carrying its scheduled and actual departure/arrival times, delay and distance measures, and the operating aircraft and airport reference attributes as profiled in silver_flights.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, assigning time, dimension, and measure roles to each profiled column so the deterministic modeling engine can generate the gold flight fact and its associated dimension views.
usage: The rendered draft is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, checked by datacontract lint, and reviewed by a human before the modeling engine consumes it to emit gold models; the mapping itself is never executed directly.
limitations: The mapping does not exclude cancelled flights (is_cancelled observed true for a nonzero subset) or rows with missing delay and arrival data (arr_delay_minutes null_rate 0.032981, dep_delay_minutes null_rate 0.029388, air_time_minutes null_rate 0.032981) nor rows with unmatched aircraft registry attributes (aircraft_manufacturer, aircraft_model, aircraft_seat_count, aircraft_engine_type, aircraft_manufacture_year all null_rate around 0.16 to 0.177); filtering or imputing these is left to consumers, and the flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport identity tuple is asserted unique only insofar as the profile's duplicate_row_rate of 0.0 shows no exact duplicate rows at 166158 total rows.
